title: Fatigue Life Estimation

engineFeatures.meaning: the entity, amount and date every output must contain

label: For "Fatigue Life Estimation": Estimate fatigue damage accumulation in structures and components from measured load histories, to plan inspections and repairs with safety margins. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Average load.
